literature.paper: Hinton, Vinyals and Dean (2015), Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
literature.problem: compress a large teacher or ensemble
literature.relevance: foundational output/function transfer alternative to internal-vector imitation
literature.limitation: transfers complete teacher output behavior and is not anomaly-residual specific

literature.paper: Penso, Achituve and Fetaya (2022), Functional Ensemble Distillation
literature.problem: ordinary ensemble outputs omit predictive uncertainty and covariance
literature.mechanism: functional distillation with mixup augmentation to expose predictive variation
literature.limitation: Bayesian ensemble setting; no native-relative dense anomaly margin effect

literature.paper: Zheng et al. (2022), Localization Distillation for Object Detection
literature.problem: feature imitation can omit localization knowledge
literature.mechanism: distill teacher prediction distributions over valuable localization regions
literature.equation: region-weighted KL between teacher and student localization distributions
literature.relevance: direct task-output/logit distillation precedent with no inference-speed sacrifice reported
literature.limitation: detection-specific heads, boxes, and region selection; not anomaly residuals

literature.paper: Park et al. (2019), Relational Knowledge Distillation
literature.mechanism: match normalized pairwise distances and angles
literature.relevance: established structural-invariant alternative to per-example direction
literature.limitation: pairwise structure and multiple terms; no dense anomaly-logit intervention

literature.paper: Reddi et al. (2021), RankDistil: Knowledge Distillation for Ranking
literature.problem: top-k ordering is the target in large ranking systems
literature.mechanism: teacher-ordered top-k/listwise or pairwise losses with negative sampling
literature.equation: Psi(t,s,P) + sum_(i in N,j in P) phi(s_j-s_i)
literature.relevance: primary precedent for rank-preserving transfer and efficient sampling
literature.limitation: large-item ranking with pair conventions; no image-anomaly residual validation

literature.mechanism: regress pretrained teacher features on normal data and score discrepancy
literature.limitation: teacher/student discrepancy remains an inference-time signal and is not native-relative

literature.paper: Wang et al. (2021), Student-Teacher Feature Pyramid Matching for Anomaly Detection
literature.equation: multi-level feature discrepancy used as the anomaly map
literature.relevance: confirms anomaly literature scores downstream discrepancy rather than residual direction
literature.limitation: feature discrepancy and different inference architecture; no native-relative margin effect

literature.mechanism: joint prediction and rejection under a coverage constraint
literature.relevance: formalizes why abstention needs an explicit coverage or utility criterion
literature.limitation: learned gate and labeled selective-risk objective are outside the proposed scope

candidates.name: FUNCTIONAL_MARGIN_EFFECT
candidates.scientific_question: Can native-relative deployed margin effects transfer useful teacher intervention without raw residual direction?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: preserve useful teacher-induced score changes; no superiority over native assumed
candidates.expected_residual_behavior: stage-mean effect constrained; stage-specific components not separately constrained
candidates.main_failure_mode: teacher effect is unhelpful or transform only changes conditioning
candidates.cheapest_falsification: symbolic/operator check, synthetic finite gradients, source audit, then one locked native comparison

candidates.name: LOCAL_RANKING_EFFECT
candidates.formulation: one fixed-neighbor ranking objective on native-relative effects
candidates.scientific_question: Is local effect ordering more useful than effect magnitude?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: possible ordering preservation without calibrated effect scale
candidates.expected_residual_behavior: many residuals satisfy the same order constraints
candidates.new_hyperparameter_count: at least pair and tie conventions
candidates.training_overhead_target: variable and higher than candidate A
candidates.cheapest_falsification: fixed pair inventory plus native ranking redundancy audit

candidates.name: SELECTIVE_ACTIONABILITY_ABSTENTION
candidates.formulation: source-defined actionability rule with native output outside selected intervention
candidates.scientific_question: Can fixed source-only actionability prevent harmful intervention?
candidates.expected_detection_effect: less native damage if weak corrections are omitted; utility is not source-identifiable
candidates.expected_residual_behavior: more abstention and exact native preservation outside selected actions
candidates.cheapest_falsification: show no outcome-free preregisterable actionability rule exists
